decisions.reason: As an agency-facing compliance product with several models, visible presentation, and fit with the firm's stated push into compliance capabilities, management is likely to defend the prior investment and keep it on the market.
Because this configurable managed hosting plan sits very close to the firm's core business, management is more likely to keep refining pricing or positioning than to concede failure and withdraw it.

Although this newer offer has a lower level of public commitment, it builds directly on the firm's security and hosting base, so management can still treat any disappointing uptake as temporary and retain it.
